items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Lockfile-only update via npm audit fix + npm update eslint @eslint/js; package.json unchanged. npm audit 40 -> 13 findings (critical 4->2, high 28->5). Remaining 13 need major upgrades (vitest 4/5, react-router 7, tailwindcss 4) and are deliberately out of scope.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Closes the in-range CVEs in react-router 6.27->6.30.6, @remix-run/router, postcss, vite 6.4.5, rollup, ws, nanoid, glob, minimatch, picomatch, brace-expansion (mostly), form-data, js-yaml, lodash, source-map-js, typescript-eslint, eslint plugin-kit. All resolved URLs from registry.npmjs.org.
